definitions.explanation: The shared opinion or will of an entire group, organization, or populace. Emphasizes that everyone in the group agrees.

examples.japanese: {国民|こくみん}の{総意|そうい}に{基|もと}づく。
examples.english: It is based on the consensus of the people.

examples.japanese: {社員|しゃいん}の{総意|そうい}で{計画|けいかく}が{決|き}まった。
examples.english: The plan was decided by the consensus of all employees.

examples.japanese: これは{部署|ぶしょ}{全体|ぜんたい}の{総意|そうい}として{提出|ていしゅつ}された{意見書|いけんしょ}です。
examples.english: This is a written opinion submitted as the consensus of the entire department.

notes:
USAGE:
{総意|そうい} carries a formal, weighty tone and implies that the group has reached unanimous or near-unanimous agreement. It appears frequently in legal, political, and organizational contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国民|こくみん}の{総意|そうい} (the will of the people)
- {総意|そうい}に{基|もと}づく (based on consensus)
- {総意|そうい}を{反映|はんえい}する (to reflect the collective will)
- {総意|そうい}として (as the consensus)
